newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures shave losses with bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures shave losses with bonds.

text.p: April 30 - U.S. stock index futures shaved losses with T-bond futures, stayed lower. Prices barely wobbled after April Chicago purchasing managers index dipped to 57.2 from 57.5 and vs forecasts for 56.2. Prices fell to 53.3, employment rose to 56.1. Fair value about 3.70 pts premium. Arb buy programs need about 4.50 pts over, sell need 2.90 pts over. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
